sections.label: Intro
sections.note: Sparse entrance, about one tap per bar on the intro chords; two long NE steps.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.note: Frame switchbacks: long lanes on the held vocal lines, hairpins on the short syllable pairs; one lane runs through the portrait-frame gallery.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 1
sections.note: Paper staircase climbing NE (ramp +3.5); the unsent folded letter opens beside it.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.note: Three-leg staircase horseshoe around the quiet court and its halftone bunny wall; one fake fork.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.note: Reed switchbacks heading back SW and passing OVER the verse-1 area (+3.5 above it).

sections.label: Breath
sections.note: Vocal-gap breath: one tap, long straight over still water.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.note: Ramp +4 onto the ear trestle: three-leg staircase U that crosses over the earlier route; five pixel bunnies under the trestle.

sections.label: Bridge
sections.note: Long quiet switchbacks through the colonnade, few bends.

sections.label: Final chorus
sections.note: Fall -4, then fan terraces: 2-4-tap zigzag steps; the frames open on alternating beats.

sections.label: Outro
sections.note: Long dawn staircase to the square quiet platform; frames stop moving.
